title: Ramification and residue degrees in a Galois normalization divide the field degree
statement: Let $B$ be a DVR domain [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], let $K=\operatorname{Frac}(B)$, let $E/K$ be a finite Galois extension [def-weil-field, def-weil-vector-space-dimension], and let $n\in\mathbf N$ satisfy $[E:K]\mid n$. Give $E$ the composite $B$-algebra structure and put $C=\operatorname{integralClosure}_B(E)$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. For every prime ideal $R\subset C$ contracting to the maximal ideal of $B$, both its ramification index $e(R/B)$ and its residue degree $f(R/B)$ divide $n$. Here the index is the length of $C_R/\mathfrak m_B C_R$, and the residue degree is $[\kappa(R):\kappa(\mathfrak m_B)]$. No invertibility hypothesis on $n$ is required.

source.place: Tag 09EB (lemma-galois-conclusion), with Tag 032L for finiteness of the integral closure.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-normal-separable-integral-closure-finite] to C. Mathlib IsIntegralClosure.isDedekindDomain and isFractionRing_of_finite_extension equip C with its Dedekind-domain and fraction-field structures. IsIntegralClosure.module_free makes C free over the principal ideal domain B, hence flat.

Restrict the finite group Gal(E/K) to C using IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction. IsGaloisGroup.of_isFractionRing gives the integral Galois action. For any R above m_B, Ideal.ncard_primesOver_mul_ramificationIdxIn_mul_inertiaDegIn yields r*(e*f)=Nat.card Gal(E/K). The common-index and common-residue-degree lemmas identify e,f with R.ramificationIdx B and R.inertiaDeg B. IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank identifies the right side with [E:K].
Each factor e and f divides r*(e*f), hence [E:K]. Compose these divisibilities with [E:K] divides n.

lean.statement:
theorem dvr_galois_normalization_ramification_dvd
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (FractionRing B) E]
    (n : ℕ)
    (hE : FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) E ∧
      IsGalois (FractionRing B) E ∧ Module.finrank (FractionRing B) E ∣ n) :
    letI : Algebra B E :=
      ((algebraMap (FractionRing B) E).comp (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))).toAlgebra
    let C := integralClosure B E
    ∀ (R : Ideal C) (hR : R.IsPrime),
    letI := hR
    R.comap (algebraMap B C) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B →
      R.ramificationIdx B ∣ n ∧ R.inertiaDeg B ∣ n
